query: Rename the Projects list to Active Projects and turn on versioning. Show me the plan first.
expected_behavior: Runs or hands over scripts/spo-update-list.ps1 with -PlanPath and without -Execute, as a dry run
States the dry run prints a structured JSON action plan and makes zero tenant writes
Does not supply a confirmation token until the user asks for the real run

query: The plan looks right. Apply it for real.
expected_behavior: Adds -Execute and -ConfirmToken UPDATE-SPO-LIST to the same command
Treats the real run as a live tenant write that the user runs, not something to run unprompted
Does not alter the plan content between the dry run and the real run

query: Delete the list and recreate it with a new name.
expected_behavior: Declines to delete and recreate, and offers renaming with this skill instead
Points to the remove-list and create-list skills if the user truly wants that
Makes no change without -Execute and the token
